steps.what: aura base points snapshot (CalcBaseValue per effect), DR group/level, duration quote
TryRefreshStackOrCreate at the FIRST unit-owned aura effect hitting this target
LoadScripts then _InitEffects: AuraEffect for EVERY unit-owned aura effect of the spell (CalculatePeriodic(create=true), CalculateAmount -> DoEffectCalc* hooks)
_AddAura: m_ownedAuras insert, no-stack removal (CanStackWith), single-target registration
ModSpellDuration, DurationMul, channel/ATTR8 haste, ATTR13 refresh extension; SetMaxDuration+SetDuration only if different from CalcMaxDuration
AddStaticApplication(target, APPLY_AURA bits of this effect)
EffectApplyAura (APPLY_AURA / APPLY_AURA_ON_PET only): _CreateAuraApplication or AddEffectToApplyEffectMask; visible slot allocation; dead target w/o ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD -> no application
damage/heal effects compute m_damage/m_healing (done+taken bonuses) at their own index
_ApplyAura: no-stack removal on recipient, aura state, HandleAuraSpecificMods, HandleEffect(REAL) per effect in index order (OnEffectApply -> handler -> AfterEffectApply)
